title: Ozon: дневные заказы, реклама по кампаниям и общий ДРР за произвольный период

Покажи за период цену клика по кампаниям и общий ДРР по дням

parameters.timezone: provider day boundaries; record source timezone

sources.meaning: all ordered items and total order value, not delivered units or buyer discounted cash
unique daily campaign spend, views, clicks; CPC + both CPO programs
targeted metadata for every ID in date reports; current state only
selected CPO applied bid from charged order rows
all-SKU CPO explicit bid from charged order rows
source-reported daily all-SKU flag; missing row means unknown

formulas.actual_campaign_cpc: CPC spend / CPC clicks; clicks=0 -> unavailable; CPO -> not applicable

prohibited: attributed order sum as unique shop orders
CPO detail added again to total spend
